blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson before this one teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These sentences and their English translations were written by people on Tatoeba (tatoeba.org), shared under CC BY 2.0 FR. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.why: After «три»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Driving for one and a half hours to get to work is a bear.
exercises.why: After «полтора»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Автобусы идут с интервалом в два ___ (час).
exercises.prompt: There is only one bus every two hours.
exercises.why: After «два»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Битва при Сан-Хасинто началась в четыре ___ (час) пополудни.
exercises.prompt: The Battle of San Jacinto began at four o'clock in the afternoon.
exercises.why: After «четыре»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
